findings.defect: Introduces first-person narration before the source identifies Jin Taekyung in third person.
findings.rationale: The opening is a subjectless impression; the explicit first-person viewpoint begins after the nightmare.

findings.current: On and on. Until every last bit of energy had been poured out and turned to ash.
findings.defect: Makes the energy, rather than the Magic Gems, appear to turn to ash.
findings.rationale: The next lines show the spent Magic Gems crumbling and scattering.
findings.replacement: On and on. Until the Magic Gems had poured out all their energy and crumbled to ash.
findings.source: 끝없이. 모든 기운을 쏟아붓고 잿가루가 되어 사라질 때까지.

findings.current: Then, making the red glow he’d shown just moments ago seem dull by comparison, his eyes turned pitch-black. He took in the new world with his gaze, looking around and sensing everything.
findings.defect: “Dull by comparison” suggests the black eyes outshine the red glow, rather than replacing its striking appearance.
findings.rationale: The contrast is between his earlier red gaze and his now-black eyes.
findings.replacement: Then, with the red glint from moments ago all but forgotten, he took in the new world through eyes that had turned pitch-black. He looked around and sensed everything.
findings.source: 그리고 조금 전 보였던 안광이 무색할 만큼, 어느덧 새카맣게 물든 눈동자로 새로운 세상을 눈에 담았다.

findings.current: I blinked at the single groan.
findings.defect: Makes the groan sound like something he reacts to rather than something he utters.
findings.rationale: The groan and blink are his simultaneous actions.
findings.replacement: I let out a short groan and blinked.

findings.current: Now, who does the Central Plains martial world revolve around, Captain? It revolves around our Captain, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon of the great Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: Treats “Captain” as a vocative addressed to the listener, when Hyuk Mujin is naming his absent captain as the answer.
findings.rationale: 우리 조장님 answers Mujin’s rhetorical question; it does not address the person hearing his boast.
findings.replacement: Now, who does the Central Plains martial world revolve around? Our Captain. The Blazing Flame Divine Dragon of the great Jin Family of Taiyuan—that’s who.
findings.source: 지금 중원 무림은 누구 중심으로 돌아가는 것이냐, 우리 조장님. 대태원진가의 열화신룡을 중심으로 돌아가게 되어 있다고.

findings.current: Because I’ve got a firm grip on the Captain’s support! Because I’m his most trusted subordinate!
findings.defect: Reverses the support relationship: Mujin claims a secure place assisting the Captain, not that he controls the Captain’s support for him.
findings.rationale: 조장님의 보좌 refers to Mujin’s position as the Captain’s aide; his repeated 딱 잡고 sets up the listener’s question.
findings.replacement: Because I’ve got my place at the Captain’s side locked down! I’m his most trusted subordinate—that’s why my place is secure.
findings.source: 나는 조장님의 보좌를 딱 잡고 살기 때문에! 가장 신뢰하는 수하이기 때문에 딱 잡고 있어요.

findings.current: Captain! Don’t move! If the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon gets fresh with me, I’ll kill him!
findings.defect: Changes Mujin’s mock direct threat to his captain into a conditional statement about a third party; “gets fresh with me” also introduces a sexual implication absent from 까불면.
findings.rationale: Mujin is acting out how boldly he supposedly speaks to Taekyung, using both addresses for the same person.
findings.replacement: Captain, don’t move! Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, mess with me and you’re dead!
findings.source: 조장님. 꼼짝 마! 열화신룡 까불면 나한테 죽어!

summary: Several localized fidelity errors affect viewpoint, the ritual’s mechanics, and Hyuk Mujin’s boast.
